data.title: Brand Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir sind ein vielfältiges Team von Schönheitsenthusiasten aus der ganzen Welt, die sich für ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld einsetzen, in dem sich jeder wertgeschätzt und respektiert fühlt.

Als führende internationale Schönheitsmarke haben wir uns zum Ziel gesetzt, qualitativ hochwertige Produkte anzubieten, die den Menschen helfen, ihren einzigartigen Sinn für Stil zu stärken. Unser innovativer und dynamischer Ansatz hat uns zur ersten Wahl für Schönheitssalons und Geschäfte weltweit gemacht. Bei uns dreht sich alles um Kreativität und individuelles Wachstum. Wir ermutigen unsere Teammitglieder, mutig zu sein und über den Tellerrandhinauszuschauen.

Dein Herz schlägt für Themen rund um UV Nagellack, Care sowie Beauty und du hast ein Gespür für die neuesten Trends? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen für die Rolle als Brand Manager (m/w/d) eine flexible und engagiertePerson, die Lust hat, unsere Marken gemeinsam mit uns in Berlin zu gestalten und weiterzubringen.

Tasks

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Weiterentwicklung der Markenstrategie und arbeitest kontinuierlich an der richtigen Markenpositionierung und Markenidentität unserer Brands.
  • Du planst und konzipierst Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und setzt diese kanalübergreifend um.
  • Mit deinem hohen Gespür für Trends entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Produktteam innovative Konzepte, die den Markt revolutionieren.
  • Du steuerst externe Agenturen und setzt Marketingmaßnahmen eigenständig und operativ um – vom Briefing bis zur finalen Umsetzung.
  • Du sorgst für eine konsistente Kommunikation über alle externen und internen Kommunikationskanäle hinweg.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der Distribution zusammen und hast ein Gespür für attraktive POS-Gestaltungen sowie -aktivierungen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit und Austausch mit Marketing, Sales und Ecommerce.

Requirements

  • Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Marketing / PR / Communications
  • Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position mit Fokus auf Beauty
  • Erste Kontakte zu Distributoren oder Erfahrungen mit dem stationären Handel von Vorteil
  • Du bist kreativ und neugierig und liebst es, Ideen zu entwickeln und umzusetzen
  • Dabei denkst du strategisch – unsere Mission und Zielgruppe immer im Blick
  • Du hast zündende kreative Ideen und Ansätze, unsere Produkte und Mission zu teilen
  • Auf dein Gespür für Gestaltung, Text & Sprache ist Verlass, du bist
  • sicher in Deutsch und Englisch gleichermaßen
  • Du arbeitest am liebsten eigenständig und organisiert und willst selbst gestalten
  • Vor-Ort-Präsenz in Berlin notwenig (mit flexibler Home Office Regelung)

Benefits

  • Corporate-Benefits-Programm
  • Zuschuss zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder andere Sachbezugslösungen (Edenred)
  • Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Programm
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Flache Hierarchien und spannende Projekte
  • Wunderschönes Office im Herzen Berlins mit guter Verkehrsanbindung
  • Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • Übernahme von Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag
  • Die Möglichkeit - als Teil eines engagierten Teams - die Entwicklung der Marke aktiv mitzugestalten

Spannende Projekte in einem agilen Umfeld: Bei Cosmo Beauty Brand House hast du die Chance, zu glänzen und wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Mit dem Fokus auf „Moments that matter“ und einer außergewöhnlichen Mitarbeitererfahrungkannst du den DACH-Markt mitgestalten und uns helfen, zu einer bedeutenden Größe zu werden!

Ein Ort voller Kreativität und Inspiration: Unser pulsierendes Büro im Herzen Berlins bietet dir hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und die Flexibilität des hybriden Arbeitens für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung ab Tag eins: Bei uns kannst du dich vom ersten Tag an weiterentwickeln, an internationalen Projekten mitwirken und zum Wachstum unserer Marke beitragen.

Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Wir bieten dir die Freiheit, dich so zu entfalten, wie es dir am besten liegt, und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Eigeninitiative wird bei uns großgeschrieben!

data.description:
Warum roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station. 

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • JOBRAD: Bleibe fit mit unserem Angebot eines Jobrads.

  • DISCOUNTS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte

Die Rolle – deine Leidenschaft

Deine Aufgaben als Standortleitung bei roadsurfer

  • Standortentwicklung: Gemeinsam mit den zentralen Fachabteilungen und deinem Team baust du eigenverantwortlich unseren Standort auf und sicherst den reibungslosen Ablauf des Tagesgeschäfts.

  • Prozessoptimierung: Du unterstützt die Umsetzung und Anpassung bestehender Standards und bringst aktiv eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung ein, z. B. bei der Koordination von Fahrzeugübergaben und -rücknahmen.

  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Du stehst in regelmäßigem Austausch mit roadsurfer-Teams in anderen Ländern und trägst zur stetigen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse bei.

  • Teamführung: Als Teamleiter/in förderst du dein Team durch strukturiertes Onboarding, gezielte Aufgabenplanung und regelmäßige Feedbacks. Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für eine hohe Qualität unserer Services.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Recruiting: Du übernimmst den Aufbau deines Teams und findest die richtigen Talente, die deine Begeisterung für roadsurfer teilen.

  • Flottenmanagement: Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Fahrzeugflotte am Standort, sorgst für deren einwandfreien Zustand und stimmst dich eng mit lokalen Servicepartnern ab.

  • Kundenberatung: Als Experte für unsere Produkte – myroadsurfer, abo, spots und rent – stehst du Kunden beratend zur Seite und schickst sie als happy roadsurfer auf die Straßen Europas.

Was du brauchst, um mit uns auf einer Welle zu surfen

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 1-2 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in den Bereichen Autovermietung, Tourismus oder verwandten Feldern; wir freuen uns auch über Quereinsteiger.

  • Erste Erfahrung in der Teamführung ist von Vorteil – wichtig sind uns vor allem Empathie und eine unterstützende Führungshaltung.

  • Eine ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Freude an einer offenen und freundlichen Kommunikation

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Lust auf eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle, in der du auch pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert agierst

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Führerschein Klasse B

Dein Gehalt

Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 37.000 EUR und 43.000 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Bereit zu surfen?

Du bist für die Aufgabe wie gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Für Rückfragen kannst du dich auch gerne jederzeit an ----- wenden, und wir melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir zurück.

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

We are more than Europe's largest campervan rental company. In 2021 we launched our platform roadsurfer spots in addition to our other products rent, abo and sales – a platform where you can discover and book unique camping spots. But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. Come ride the wave with us!

data.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview :

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you'll join Wonderland, Jimdo's internal Platform Engineering team responsible for the cloud platform that every engineering team builds on. We solve infrastructure challenges once so product engineers don't have to—providing a reliable, secure and self-service platform that powers deployments, observability, networking and developer workflows across the company.

You'll work on a modern stack including AWS (EKS), Kubernetes, Terraform, Cloudflare, Vault, Grafana Cloud and GitHub Actions, helping evolve the platform while improving reliability, developer experience and operational efficiency. As part of a small, senior team, you'll have broad ownership, influence platform strategy, and build solutions that have an impact across every product team at Jimdo.

Your impact:

  • Design and manage scalable cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Kubernetes.

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and GitOps deployment workflows.

  • Enhance observability through monitoring, logging, alerting and incident management.

  • Implement platform security, secrets management and infrastructure compliance.

  • Partner with engineering teams to improve deployment reliability and developer experience.

  • Contribute production-quality code, primarily in Go, to platform tooling and automation.

  • Explore and integrate AI tools that improve engineering productivity and operational excellence.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering.

  • Strong experience with Kubernetes in production.

  • Deep knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience with AWS (EKS preferred).

  • Experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or similar CI/CD tooling.

  • Familiarity with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or modern observability platforms.

  • Comfortable writing production code (Go preferred).

  • Passion for platform engineering, automation and solving problems at scale.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity, with an Employee-led DEI Council and active ERGs that ensure everyone's voices are heard.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and Hack Weeks, Deep Work Thursdays, conferences and access to technical eLearning platforms. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package: 

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.

data.title: Data Engineer
data.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

To achieve our ambitious goals, we’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Enablement Engineering team and help us build a world-class data platform. Superhuman's success depends on its ability to efficiently ingest over 60 to 70 billion daily events while using our systems to improve our product. This role presents a unique opportunity to experience all aspects of building complex software systems, including contributing to the strategy, defining the architecture, and developing and shipping to production.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. You can hear more from our team on our technical blog.

Your Impact

As a Data Engineer on the Data Enablement Engineering team, you will shape the architecture and technical strategy of our data platform, ensuring scalability, security, and efficiency across data engineering systems. You will design and lead the implementation of robust, scalable, and reliable systems that handle large volumes of data, empowering both product features and data-driven decision-making across the company. Your work will span areas such as real-time & ETL data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data lakes, and back-end services.

This role requires you to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including back-end engineers, Analytics engineering, Data Science engineering, and machine learning teams, to drive initiatives that support various business outcomes. As a senior IC, you will also mentor engineers and help set the strategic direction for the platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and lead the development of large-scale systems for data pipelines, data lakes that handle billions of daily events.

  • Design and implement solutions that ensure data is available, secure, and scalable across the platform, enabling real-time and batch processing.

  • Make high-level architectural decisions about system design, technology choices, and platform evolution, ensuring scalability and long-term sustainability.

  • Collaborate with key stakeholders, such as product teams, data engineers, back-end developers, and ML engineers, to build tools & frameworks that power analytics, product features, and data-driven workflows.

  • Work with business stakeholders such as Analytics Eng, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Product teams to build high-impact data products enabling business-critical features, research, and experimentation with a focus on efficiency and alignment

  • Collaborate with Leadership in devising the charter and technical roadmaps

  • Mentor engineers across back-end infrastructure and data engineering disciplines, fostering a culture of collaboration and technical excellence.

Qualifications

  • Has experience in large-scale distributed computing systems, with expertise in both data engineering and data modeling.

  • Has experience managing live production environments, including high-load systems or data-intensive workflows, with a focus on uptime and reliability.

  • Expert in SQL and proficient in technologies like Spark, Kafka, Terraform, and in at least one programming language commonly used for data engineering (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java).

  • Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT design patterns, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Dagster), and data quality frameworks.

  • Ability to design scalable, secure, and maintainable data models and architectures, and understanding of data governance, privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).

  • Hands-on experience with modern data storage technologies (e.g., Delta Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

  • Is a strategic thinker, able to evaluate whether to build internally or leverage third-party solutions, ensuring the right balance between speed, scalability, and long-term viability.

  • Is an excellent communicator and collaborator, able to work across diverse teams and stakeholders, translates business needs into robust data solutions, and ensures alignment on technical goals.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal to zero guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional growth: We hire people we trust, and we give team members autonomy to do their best work. We also support professional development with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. We have a highly collaborative culture. We also take time to celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific events and programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package that includes superior health care. We also offer ample and defined time off, catered lunches, gym and recreation stipends, admission discounts, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

Compensation range: €91,000–€125,000

We encourage you to apply

data.description:

Unser Anspruch ist es nicht, dem Markt zu folgen – sondern ihn aktiv mitzugestalten.

talenthafen ist Vorreiter in der Innovation des Recruitings.
Wir leben Fortschritt. Wir entwickeln eigene Systeme, implementieren Automatisierungen und integrieren künstliche Intelligenzen konsequent in unsere internen Prozesse und Kundenstrukturen. data.title: DTC Performance Video Editor AI-First (Freelance)
data.description:
We are agencro, a CRO and direct-response agency for e-commerce brands: advertorials, landing pages, online shops and email for our clients - plus our own brands, where we also run paid ads ourselves.

We work AI-first: AI produces the volume, a small team with real taste directs and finishes it. Small remote team, short paths, your work goes live fast.

The ads for our own brands and the visuals on our client pages win or lose on creative: hooks, retention, clarity. Right now that sits with us. We want one person who owns moving image.

This is not a "make it look nice" editing role. Every ad and every graphic you ship exists to convert.

Tasks

  • Edit performance video ads for our own brands: UGC ads, AI-generated creatives, VSL-style videos and testimonial cuts for Meta, TikTok and paid social - going into real spend.
  • Build strong hooks: retention-focused edits, platform-native pacing, captions and variants of the first three seconds.
  • Motion and conversion graphics for client projects: animated sections, GIFs and conversion visuals for advertorials, online shops, landing pages and email.
  • Produce with AI as the engine: AI video and image tools (e.g. Kling, Runway, Nano Banana, Veo or similar) are your primary production line for footage, b-roll and variants.
  • Finish with craft: you know when AI output is not good enough and you fix it - cut, timing, sound, brand-fit (Premiere/After Effects or equivalent).

Requirements

What winning looks like

  • Your creatives perform in real campaigns.
  • Hook Rate, CTR, CPA and watch time move because of your work.
  • Fast turnaround and clean iteration cycles: brief in, first cut out, feedback, ship.

Who we're NOT looking for

  • Brand-awareness editors. Our ads and pages have to convert.
  • AI sceptics. AI tools are the production engine here, not a gimmick.
  • People who need a lot of hand-holding. You get a brief and an angle, then you own it.
  • Slow perfectionists. We iterate in live campaigns.

Who we ARE looking for

  • You understand direct-response video: hooks, retention, pacing, conversion psychology.
  • You already produce with AI video tools and keep up with the toolset.
  • You have real craft on top: Premiere Pro + After Effects or equivalent, used to elevate AI output.
  • DTC/e-commerce creative experience is a plus.
  • Fast, reliable, self-managing, proactive communicator.

Benefits

In return for these skills, you'll work in a team of young, driven people, structure your day the way you want, work from wherever you want, and get challenged every single day.

You'll get to see a wide range of e-commerce projects - from health and beauty to fitness and fashion - and gain an incredibly deep look into the world of online marketing.

Instead of sitting on one thing for weeks, your tasks change from day to day, so you'll never get bored. There's always a challenge to solve, a project to push or a process to improve.

How to apply

  1. Send 3-5 examples of ads you did with AI - with a sentence on what you did and which tools (including AI) you used.
  2. One short paragraph: your AI workflow today - which tools, for what.

data.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

About the role

We're hiring a high-ownership sales operator to drive sourced pipeline and revenue through the Microsoft Azure channel.

This is a quota-carrying, field-facing role. You'll map Microsoft's ISV and enterprise field org, activate co-sell motions with the right PDMs and AEs, and build the repeatable sales plays that move customers to Fireworks AI through Azure Foundry. You'll own the forecast and the number.

The playbook doesn't fully exist yet. You'll have real influence over how we engage Microsoft's field teams, what good looks like for partner-sourced pipeline, and how we build a co-sell motion that scales across ISV and enterprise segments. If you thrive when you're creating from scratch and can hold yourself accountable to a number while doing it, this is the role.

What you'll own

Pipeline and revenue

  • Source and own a pipeline target through the Microsoft Azure channel

  • Co-sell qualified opportunities with Microsoft ISV and enterprise AEs and PDMs

  • Run weekly forecasting cadences with accurate CRM hygiene and clear escalation visibility

Team mapping and stakeholder management

  • Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft's field org across ISV and enterprise-facing teams - who owns which accounts, who moves deals, who has co-sell budget

  • Develop working relationships with PDMs, field AEs, and ISV partner managers at Microsoft

  • Serve as Fireworks AI's primary point of contact for joint business reviews, pipeline reviews, and co-sell coordination

Sales plays and enablement

  • Develop sales plays tailored to the ISV and enterprise motion - positioning Fireworks AI's inference platform against the decision criteria that matter in each segment

  • Build and deliver enablement for Microsoft field sellers on Fireworks AI: clear, crisp positioning they can use in front of customers without a technical translator

  • Design the intake, escalation, and co-sell workflows that keep deals from stalling

Joint planning and operations

  • Own joint business planning with Microsoft counterparts: territory plans, account maps, co-sell targets, and QBR cadences

  • Coordinate co-marketing moments (joint events, solution briefs, field plays) that generate ISV and enterprise pipeline

  • Surface field intelligence from Microsoft conversations back to Fireworks AI's product and GTM teams

You're a good fit if you

  • Have 7+ years in GTM, partnerships, or field sales at a technology company - and a track record of operating fast when the environment changes

  • Know how Microsoft's field org actually works: account teams, SSPs, GBBs, marketplace mechanics, co-sell programs, MACC spend, partner incentives - and how to activate them at the deal level

  • Build systems, not just run plays. You document the motion, create the playbooks, and make it repeatable

  • Are comfortable owning a number before all the conditions are perfect, and stay accountable on pipeline sourcing, progression, forecasting

  • Can communicate clearly and concisely - you translate complex platform capabilities into a value story a non-technical field seller can use in front of a customer

  • Hold yourself accountable to pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy - not just relationship depth

The technical bar

This is not an engineering role. But it requires genuine curiosity about how AI inference platforms work.

You'll need working fluency in model serving, inference optimization, and AI training infrastructure - enough to speak credibly about why Fireworks AI's platform matters to ISVs and enterprises evaluating options in the market. If you don't have that fluency today, you can build it here - we'll help. What you can't be is someone who deflects every technical question or can't hold a credible 30-minute conversation with a solutions architect or a technical evaluator.

The through-line: you need to understand what we do well enough to translate it for someone who doesn't. That's the bar.

Nice to have

  • Experience working at or within a hyperscaler partner ecosystem (Microsoft, AWS, GCP)

  • Experience selling or partnering in AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, or MLOps

  • Experience working with ISVs at the platform layer - understanding their build-vs-buy decisions and procurement dynamics

  • Non-linear career path - varied, scrappy backgrounds carry real weight here

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

Compensation: £200K – £220K • Offers Equity

The Role:

SIs are Fireworks' highest-leverage GTM channel and this function does not exist yet. The person in this role originates and structures the deals, builds the partners, makes them technically capable, and embeds Fireworks into how they sell. The weight is upstream: strategy and origination, not day-to-day partner management.

What You Will Own: 

Originate and Structure

  • Source and close first-of-a-kind commercial agreements with Tier-1 SIs - framework deals, global MoUs, joint offering structures - where no playbook exists

  • Define the multi-practice value proposition; align SI executive and line-of-business leadership on why Fireworks and how joint delivery creates margin for both sides

  • Navigate matrixed GSI org structures to secure internal mandates for dedicated practices or CoEs, aligning competing service lines on governance and delivery standards

  • Define co-delivery swimlanes and market ownership to prevent channel conflict and protect delivery quality as the partner ecosystem scales

Recruit and Develop

  • Identify and recruit Tier-1 SI partners with credible AI practices, client access in target verticals, and appetite to build a Fireworks capability

  • Build conviction at every level - make the commercial and technical case from alliance desk to equity partner

  • Connect Fireworks engineers, sales, and product to their counterparts at the partner; establish functional working relationships, not just an alliance desk

  • Guide partners through standing up a Fireworks service offering: capability definition, staffing model, pricing, and GTM positioning

Enable

  • Design and own FDE certification: inference, fine-tuning pipelines, production deployment - with a track covering SFT, RLHF, and model adaptation

  • Build the operating model: how projects flow to partners, support tiers, escalation to the Fireworks technical bench, and commercial attribution

  • Run the direct interface desk - standing technical bridge between partner delivery teams and Fireworks engineers for in-flight engagements

  • Own model update continuity: when Fireworks ships, re-certify partners before delivery is disrupted

Embed

  • Place Fireworks in SI practice playbooks and internal solution frameworks - the default inference layer when their AI practices architect for clients

  • Produce joint innovation content with named Fireworks placement: reference architectures, solution briefs, and thought leadership under partner credentials

  • Develop case studies with specific, attributable outcomes - latency, cost reduction, model quality - with named clients where possible

  • Build at practice lead and delivery principal level across all active SI partners, not just alliance managers

Who You Are: 

What matters is that you are a practitioner - close enough to how SIs work to know where the leverage is and where the friction lives. 

You are technical enough to earn credibility with FDEs and ML engineers - you understand what SFT and RL mean in production and can design enablement that builds those capabilities in others. GSI experience is a strong plus, not a requirement. What is required: you have closed non-standard strategic agreements before, and you build things that do not exist yet.

What You Bring:

  • 8-10 years across top-tier consulting, enterprise technology or AI/ML vendor roles, or senior SI alliance leadership - with direct exposure to how GSIs structure, sell, and deliver

  • Track record closing non-standard strategic agreements: MoUs, framework deals, joint offering structures with major GSIs or consulting firms

  • Working knowledge of how GSIs operate - practice formation, CoE funding, delivery authority, internal service line competition - from the inside or from working alongside them closely

  • ML stack fluency sufficient to design and assess technical enablement: fine-tuning, inference, deployment pipelines

  • Demonstrated 0-to-1 program or function builds; not inherited playbooks

  • Operates at C-suite and equity partner level; measures success by pipeline originated and practice maturity, not activity

Bonus: 

  • Time inside the AI practice of a leading GSI or MBB firm

  • Hands-on post-training experience: SFT, RL, or RLHF in delivery or program management

  • Existing relationships at practice lead or delivery principal level within major consulting or SI AI practices

Why Fireworks?

data.title: AI Field Engineer, EMEA
data.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

In the last few months alone we launched Fireworks Training, partnered with Microsoft Azure Foundry, and published research straight from our production systems. A few examples of what that looks like in practice:

  • Frontier RL is cheaper than the mega-cluster narrative suggests: we ran cross-region rollouts using 98% sparse weight deltas and published what we learned. (blog)

  • Open source agents with frontier advisors: matching frontier performance through training and harness engineering. (blog)

  • The fine-tuning bottleneck is not the algorithm: integration friction and iteration speed are what actually stall teams; we documented the patterns across dozens of customer engagements. (blog)

The Role

AI Field Engineers at Fireworks are the technical tip of the spear. You embed with our most ambitious customers and technology partners to turn complex AI problems into production systems, fast. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. You are hands-on-keyboard building POCs, MVPs, and production integrations, while also holding your own in executive-level conversations about architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

You spend most of your time building. You ship code, run benchmarks, debug production issues, and architect deployments. But you also lead discovery conversations, align stakeholders, and translate customer pain points into product improvements that compress the feedback loop from field to roadmap. This is a role for engineers who are comfortable on-site with customers, building the relationships and trust that happen in person, not just over a call.

The Segment

As a Field Engineer in the Enterprise track you will work with large organizations and digital-native companies adopting GenAI across the business. These engagements span more stakeholders and longer cycles, so you will manage executive relationships and align teams while staying hands-on in the code. The emphasis is on pairing strong technical delivery with the executive presence to earn trust across an org: discovery, solution design, POC execution, and the path to production at enterprise scale.

What You'll Work On

Technical Delivery and Deployment

  • Build end-to-end POCs and MVPs alongside customer engineering teams, working inside their codebases, infrastructure, and constraints.

  • For customers whose core product is built on GenAI, architect the inference foundations that capability depends on, and size deployments so they can scale in their market without infrastructure becoming the bottleneck.

  • Run load tests and establish latency, throughput, and cost baselines against realistic customer traffic profiles, and tune deployments to hit those targets

  • Deploy and validate new model families on inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang), determining optimal shapes, quantization configs, and serving patterns across workloads.

Model Strategy and Fine-Tuning

  • Guide customers on model selection, fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT), and evaluation methodology.

  • Build and run fine-tuning pipelines directly with customers, navigating trade-offs between model families, compute cost, and quality targets.

  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks that measure production-quality metrics, not just benchmark scores.

Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management

  • Many of our customers exist because of GenAI. Help them bake frontier model capabilities into their core offering and turn that into a durable competitive edge.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to unpack customer pain points, constraints, and success criteria before proposing solutions.

  • Own the technical relationship from first engagement through production deployment. Earn trust with ML engineers and VPs in the same meeting.

  • Spend time on-site with customers. Build trust and momentum in person, embedding with their teams where the work happens.

Product Feedback and Platform Improvement

  • Identify recurring customer pain points and translate them into concrete product proposals, working directly with engineering and product to ship fixes and features.

  • Codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute them back to internal tooling, documentation, and the platform itself.

  • Feed customer signals (deployment patterns, failure modes, feature gaps) back into the product roadmap with specificity and urgency.

What We're Looking For

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, ML Engineer with field exposure, or technical founder.

  • Demonstrated ability to build production software with customers, not just advise on it. You have shipped code running in someone else's production environment.

  • Strong Python skills. Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging production code. Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure engineering.

  • Working knowledge of the LLM stack: inference trade-offs, model serving, fine-tuning workflows (SFT at minimum; DPO/RFT a strong plus).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying models on GPU infrastructure.

  • Exceptional communication: able to run a sharp discovery call, present to a VP, and debug a latency issue with an ML engineer in the same afternoon.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years in technical field or engineering roles.

  • Experience with inference serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and tuning deployments for real workloads.

  • Experience operating as a technical authority inside a customer's environment building within their infrastructure, navigating their constraints, and shipping code that runs in their production systems.

  • Track record taking GenAI POCs from prototype to production-scale deployments.

  • Experience with hyperscaler AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex).

  • Experience building or integrating agentic systems, tool-use chains, or AI-native developer toolchains.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

data.title: Sales Compensation Lead
data.description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role

Reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations, the Sales Commissions Lead owns sales compensation end-to-end: plan strategy and design, field communication, dispute resolution, forecasting of commission expense, and the systems that turn closed deals and usage into accurate, trusted payouts.

This is not a pure admin seat and not a blank-slate build. You inherit a working in-house commissions stack and extend it — plan docs, calculators, data pipelines, reporting, and payout workflows — while partnering tightly with FP&A, HR/People Ops, Sales leadership, and Data Engineering. You will own compensation for a rapidly scaling GTM org (300+ commissionable sellers across pre-sales and post-sales roles).

Consumption and hybrid commit + usage economics are core to how we sell and how we pay. The right candidate has already owned commissions in a usage-based or hybrid commercial model — not only license ARR — and can design plans that drive the right field behavior without breaking Finance trust.

The right candidate is an AI-native builder: hands-on with agentic tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), shipping automation into the commissions operating system rather than managing a spreadsheet forever.

Responsibilities

Plan Strategy & Design

  • Own sales compensation plan strategy and execution across AE, manager, and pre-/post-sales overlay roles.

  • Design and iterate consumption-aware and hybrid commit + usage plans that align seller incentives with company goals (new logos, expansion, and healthy revenue mix).

  • Partner with Sales leadership, FP&A, and HR on plan changes, mid-period policy decisions, and clear field communication — including how changes are grandfathered and measured after the fact.

Payout Operations & Trust

  • Own the quarter close for commissions: eligibility, calculations, exceptions, audits, and payout packages Sales and Finance will stand behind.

  • Run dispute resolution with judgment — protect plan integrity while staying credible with FLMs and reps.

  • Maintain definitional clarity (what counts as commissionable production, how credit is assigned, how overlays interact) and keep plan language, exhibits, and systems in sync.

Systems, Forecasting & Automation

  • Inherit and extend our in-house commissions tooling and data pipelines — do not rip-and-replace for a vendor by default.

  • Drive end-to-end automation of plan modeling, commission forecasting, attainment reporting, and payout production.

  • Partner with Data Engineering and GTM Engineering on source-of-truth data (CRM, billing/usage, roster/quotas) so calculations are reproducible and auditable.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Be the commissions point of contact for Sales VPs/FLMs, FP&A (commission expense and accruals), HR (exhibits, offers, terminations), and Data Eng.

  • Produce executive-ready views of commission cost, plan health, and incentive risk — recommendations, not just tables.

AI-Native Operations

  • Build agentic workflows into how commissions runs: rule interpretation, edge-case triage, rep-facing explanations, regression checks on plan changes, and automated reporting.

  • Raise the bar for what "done" looks like: machine-readable plan logic, versioned assumptions, and tooling the field can self-serve against.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in sales commissions, incentive compensation, or sales ops with deep commissions ownership; senior IC depth at a P4–P5 equivalent

  • Has familiarity with and owned multiple steps of end-to-end commission (plan design + payout ops), not only one side of the house

  • Hands-on experience designing and administering plans in a consumption-based or hybrid commit + usage commercial model

  • Strong systems builder: SQL (or equivalent) against CRM/billing data; comfortable extending in-house calculators and pipelines rather than only operating a packaged ICM tool

  • Proven cross-functional operator with Sales, FP&A, HR, and technical partners — can say no to a bad exception and still keep trust

  • Actively building with AI/agentic tools in current work; can name specific automation they've shipped (not "I use ChatGPT")

  • Excellent written communication: can explain plan mechanics to a rep in plain language and to Finance in audit-ready form

Preferred

  • Experience at an AI/ML infrastructure, developer tools, or API-first company

  • Has scaled commissions through a high-growth headcount ramp (hundreds of sellers)

  • Familiarity with manager overrides, overlay roles (e.g. SAs / field engineers), marketplace/channel credit, and self-serve → sales-assisted conversion credit

  • Prior ownership of commission expense forecasting / accruals partnership with FP&A

data.title: Total Rewards Manager
data.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Manager, you will lead Legora's compensation architecture and equity programs — the two pillars that most directly shape how we attract and retain exceptional talent at every level of the company.

Reporting into the VP of Total Rewards, you'll be the lead on compensation banding, equity administration, and the frameworks that ensure every compensation decision is principled, competitive, and fair. This is a builder's role: you'll be translating our reward strategy into systems that scale with us as we continue to grow across markets.

What you will do

  • Define and maintain compensation bands across Legora's job architecture, ensuring levels are consistently applied and market-aligned across functions and geographies.

  • Lead the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end: benchmarking, calibration, offer modelling, and manager communication.

  • Be Legora's people-side expert on equity — deeply understanding our equity programs, employee participation, vesting cycles, and how equity connects to performance and total reward.

  • Implement and evolve our compensation frameworks and total reward practices in line with the global strategy, ensuring they remain competitive, equitable, and transparent.

  • Conduct ongoing market benchmarking across all markets, using data to ensure Legora stays ahead of the curve.

  • Partner with Finance on compensation planning, equity modelling, and reward analytics.

  • Collaborate with Legal to ensure compliance in compensation and equity practices across all jurisdictions.

  • Build clear toolkits, templates, and policies that make reward decisions scalable and consistent across the organization.

  • Educate and enable managers and employees to understand, articulate, and trust our reward philosophy.

Who you are

You think in systems. You love the intersection of data, structure, and people — and you get energised by building things that make complex decisions feel simple and fair.

We think you'll thrive here if you have:

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

Summary

Menlo Security is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Threat Protection and ShadowAI team in the UK. This team ensures that users can safely browse the web through Menlo's secure cloud — protecting them from malicious sites (including those built or operated with AI) and securing access to authorised web applications. The services this team builds are core to Menlo's secure enterprise browser for both humans and AI agents, which puts you at the centre of one of the most active problems in enterprise security right now: how organisations gain visibility into and control over unsanctioned AI usage without blocking it entirely. The team applies AI in how it builds as well — code assistants, AI-assisted test generation, and LLM-supported log and incident analysis — so you will be using these tools alongside defending against their misuse.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • Reliable, performant delivery of Threat Protection and ShadowAI services that detect and control risky web and generative AI application usage for Menlo customers.

  • End-to-end ownership of assigned features, from design through production operation and iteration.

Success Metrics / KPIs: (drafted for hiring manager review and adjustment)

  • Service availability and latency for owned components meet or exceed team SLOs.

  • Features delivered on committed roadmap dates, with quality measured by post-release defect and rollback rates.

  • Automated test coverage maintained or improved on owned code paths.

  • Detection accuracy for AI application and malicious site coverage, measured by false positive and false negative rates.

  • Mean time to detect and resolve production issues in owned services.

data.description:
Project Delivery Technician (Hardware)

Contract: Full-Time, Permanent
Working Location: Basingstoke Head Office
Working Pattern: On-site 5 Days/Week

Overview:

Every Hawk-Eye system that goes live in a stadium starts life on a bench in Basingstoke. Getting it right there is what makes it work out there, in front of a crowd, first time, with no chance to stop and fix it.

As a Project Delivery Technician (Hardware), you'll build that kit. You'll assemble and configure hardware from individual components up to complete subsystems, test every build against spec, and make sure what leaves the building is ready to deploy. You'll work closely with our Hardware Project Managers to hit build schedules, keep stock and project bays in order, and diagnose problems as they come up. It's hands-on, practical work on the technology behind some of the biggest moments in sport.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Hardware Assembly: Assemble computer systems, servers, or other hardware components based on project specifications and technical documentation. Install and secure components such as processors, memory, storage devices, motherboards, power supplies, and peripheral devices into larger sub systems.

  • Configuration and Integration: Configure hardware components including specific operational settings, and operating systems. Integrate hardware components with software applications and ensure compatibility and proper functionality.

  • Documentation: Maintain accurate records of hardware configurations, specifications, and build and testing checklists.

  • Logistics and Inventory Management: Manage and liaise hardware inventory with the stock controller and warehousing teams ensuring all project bays and shelving are fit for project builds and inventory is clearly accessible.

  • Coordinate: Collaborate with Project Managers (Hardware) to make sure you are aware of the build schedules and program to ensure all builds are completed on time for logistics and operational delivery. Highlight any issues that occur which could impact the timeline to key stakeholders including Hardware Project Managers and the Project Delivery Manager

  • Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues that occur during builds. Coordinate any learnings or feedback to the Hardware Support Manager as documentation may be required an update or a full-cycle refinement within Project Design.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay updated on the latest hardware and technology trends to provide innovative solutions to clients.

  • Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with industry standards, safety regulations, and best practices during hardware assembly and installation. Maintain a safe and clean working environment.


Requirements:

  • The role requires an eagerness to learn new skills and gain new knowledge to cover the continuously evolving hardware technologies used by all departments

  • Must possess good communication and organisational skills

  • Must demonstrate the ability to multitask, think analytically and problem solve

  • Must demonstrate a diligent & organised approach to resolving technical issues and supplying clear solutions, including replacement equipment, within the timescales available

  • Must take responsibility for their own work, standards and training program

  • Must be competent in the use of all tooling and take responsibility for the H&S of themselves and those around them

  • Must be flexible in order to facilitate up to 7 days on-site per year to ensure that the Operational Team adheres to hardware processes and procedures and suggests improvements where possible. This may include operational support under rare, business-critical circumstances

Equal Opportunity Employer

We ensure all employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion, age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - (HawkAI)
data.description:
Join Our Team as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (HawkAI) at Hawk-Eye Innovations

Location: Hybrid working – minimum 2 days per week in the office

Office: Budapest, Váci út 144-150, 1138 Hungary

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our HawkAI team builds the foundational machine learning infrastructure that powers the future of sports intelligence. This is a build-from-zero role designed to bridge the gap between machine learning engineering and real-world application. You will be responsible for building the first-pass applications and services that sit on top of the HawkAI Engine, translating cutting-edge ML models and data pipelines into working, demonstrable software. If you thrive on autonomy, rapid execution, and leveraging modern AI-assisted workflows to build products from scratch, this is where you belong.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer who can comfortably navigate the entire stack to get credible first versions into the hands of users. You won't be handed a fully scoped brief; instead, you’ll work closely with ML engineers to figure out what a credible first pass looks like, making high-leverage architectural choices and proving out new product opportunities.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build-from-Zero Applications: Move across the entire stack to design, build, and deploy the first working software applications and services powered by the HawkAI Engine.

  • Bridge ML and Product: Translate complex ML models and real-time data pipelines into responsive, high-throughput APIs and intuitive user interfaces.

  • AI-Accelerated Development: Maximize your build velocity by deeply integrating modern AI-assisted and agentic development tools into your day-to-day workflow, while retaining strict human oversight on software architecture and data integrity.

  • Real-Time Visualization: Design and implement high-performance interfaces to stream and visualize 2D sports data with minimal latency.

  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of early-stage applications, from cloud infrastructure (AWS) and CI/CD deployment to frontline delivery.

What We're Looking For

  • Versatile Full-Stack Expertise: Broad hands-on experience moving fluidly across backend, frontend, and deployment, specifically with Java, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, and modern responsive web technologies (HTML5/CSS3).

  • AWS & Infrastructure: Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying end-to-end cloud solutions on AWS infrastructure.

  • CI/CD & DevOps: Proven capability deploying production-ready CI/CD pipelines using Docker and GitHub Actions.

  • Data Streaming & 2D Rendering: Experience streaming, processing, and visualizing dynamic data using 2D rendering engine tools.

  • ML Integration: Experience building APIs and microservices that integrate directly with ML models, keeping latency and throughput constraints front-of-mind.

  • Pragmatic Quality: The ability to write high-quality, testable, and maintainable code that accounts for edge cases, even when executing at high speeds.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with 2D rendering libraries like PixiJS or mobile frameworks like React Native.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS SageMaker, AWS Bedrock, SQL, Redis/Valkey, or infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

  • Familiarity with building or working alongside agentic AI systems.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not an ML Engineering Role: You will work directly with ML engineers, but your focus is building product services on top of their models.

  • Not a Fixed Roadmap Role: You won't execute against rigid specs; a key part of your initial phase is defining what the product should actually be.

  • Not a Management Role: This is a dedicated, high-impact individual contributor position.

  • Not a Long-Term Maintenance Role: You focus on turning 0 to 1; once opportunities are proven, dedicated teams scale and maintain them.

Hungary Benefits

  • Annual Leave: Standard according to local labour law.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model (2 days in our Budapest office per week).

  • Access to Sporting Events: Priority access and tickets to major sporting events.

  • Sony Group Discounts: Generous discounts across Sony Group products and services.

  • Other Benefits: Flexible Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, Nursery & Kindergarten contributions, Annual MOL Bubi Pass), Private Medical Insurance, Life & Accident Insurance, MindentMent Dental Clinic discounts, Seniority Awards, and an Employee Assistance Program.

data.title: Head of New Business (m/f/d) - EMEA
data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of New Business — EMEA to lead and transform our regional new business function. This is a building role. You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and own the EMEA new business strategy, tactical plan, team, and execution of how Statista wins net-new logos across mid-market and enterprise accounts. You will work within Statista’s global commercial strategy while using regional insight to influence the evolution of our global playbooks and policies.

You will inherit a small, capable, and ambitious team — and the mandate to build it into the engine that powers our 2027 growth. You will shape and embed the EMEA playbook, raise the bar, and build a high-performance culture, working in close alignment with our global commercial framework.

What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Installed a consistent EMEA new-business operating cadence covering pipeline creation, qualification, deal inspection, and forecasting.

  • Built a repeatable mid-market and enterprise acquisition playbook across inbound, outbound, and account-based motions.

  • Raised sales capability through structured coaching and practical adoption of MEDDICC or an equivalent enterprise methodology.

  • Improved pipeline quality, forecast confidence, and economic-buyer engagement across the team.

  • Defined the team structure and hiring plan required to support Statista’s 2027 growth ambitions.

What You Will Own

  • Hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing new business organisation, including Account Executives and close partnership with SDR leadership.

  • Building and embedding the operating cadence — pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecast governance — that turns activity into outcomes.

data.description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As a Customer Care Associate – Enterprise, you’ll be dedicated to one of our strategic enterprise accounts and play a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer experience. You’ll own the customer experience from the first point of contact, collaborating with the teams across implementation, customer success, and solutions engineering to drive resolution and ensure consistent delivery at enterprise scale.

This role combines day-to-day customer support with continuous improvement. You’ll develop a strong understanding of the customer experience, identify patterns and areas of friction, and help shape how we support Choco’s key customers at scale.

What you'll do

  • Own day-to-day customer support for a strategic enterprise account across chat, email, and WhatsApp, providing fast, empathetic, and effective resolutions.

  • Deliver against our service standards, taking responsibility for response and resolution times, SLAs, and customer satisfaction.

  • Troubleshoot and solve problems, diagnosing issues independently and bringing in the right internal teams when deeper technical or operational support is needed.

  • Partner with customer success and implementation to deliver against account priorities, coordinate upcoming changes, and resolve recurring customer issues.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of each account’s users, workflows, and operational context to resolve issues effectively and anticipate support needs.

  • Turn frontline customer insights into improvements, identifying recurring problems and helping improve our processes, documentation, product, and ways of working.

  • Contribute to how we scale Customer Care, sharing learnings across our global Care organization and supporting the coaching and coordination of external agents.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing role. Experience in B2B, SaaS, tech, or enterprise support is a strong plus.

  • Full professional proficiency in English and Turkish (C1+). Proficiency in French, German, or Spanish is a plus.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the judgment to diagnose issues, prioritize effectively, and follow them through to resolution.

  • The ability to operate in a high-volume environment. You can prioritize multiple conversations and requests without compromising the quality of the customer experience.

  • A genuinely customer-focused mindset. You communicate clearly, stay patient under pressure, adapt quickly, and work well across teams.

  • Ability to coach and develop external agents, helping them ramp up quickly and consistently meet the quality standards expected for our enterprise customers.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Telehealth Medical Doctor at AIOS

We're building a world-class team.

This is a part-time, sessional role — self-employed or contractor — with 5 to 10 sessions a week, flexible including evenings and weekends. You'll run synchronous 15 minute video consults, so you'll need to be online and available for the slots you book, rather than working async.

You'll report directly to Saim Dalvi, Chief Clinical Strategy Officer, and work under the clinical direction of Prof Frank Joseph, Medical Lead. We're intense, so you'll be too.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video assessment: Run 15 minute synchronous video consults to protocol for BMI 25-27 patients, starting on time as booked.

  • Documentation: Write notes that make the decision defensible and let another clinician take over the follow-up without needing to ask.

  • Independent decisions: Prescribe, redirect or decline on clinical merit.

  • Off-label governance: Hold consent conversations and produce documentation that meets GMC good practice on unlicensed and off-label prescribing.

  • Verification: Blend shared decision making with independent verification where possible.

  • Red flags: Screen for eating disorder risk, pregnancy and contraindications, and escalate within 24 hours.

  • Audit and peer review: Participate in case review and act on audit findings.

  • Feedback loop: Surface edge cases and protocol gaps to the Medical Lead and Clinical Product team.

KPIs

  • Credentialed and live: GMC, DBS, induction and ClinicOS protocol sign-off

  • On time, every time: consults held to when they're booked, zero missed appointments

  • Throughput with quality: 15 minute video consults held to time, documentation audit pass rate 95%+

  • Defensible documentation: notes robust enough that any clinician picking up the follow-up can take over without asking questions

  • Decision quality: prescriptions in the 25-27 cohort carry a documented comorbidity, an off-label rationale and recorded consent, every time

  • Escalation discipline: red flags escalated within 24 hours through the escalation pathway

Need to Have

  • Registration: Full GMC registration with licence to practise, on the GP Register, revalidation current, clean.

  • Prescribing Knowledge: Working fluency in off-label prescribing obligations (GMC Good practice in prescribing and managing medicines)

  • Telehealth Experience: Telehealth or remote consultation experience

  • Documentation: Excellent documentation skills — robust notes that make the decision defensible and easy for another clinician to pick up and take over

  • Reliability: Consults held on time as booked

  • Eligibility: UK-based with right to work, enhanced DBS

  • Availability: 5-10 sessions per week including some evenings and weekends

  • Safety Mindset: Demonstrated comfort declining a paying patient and documenting why

Nice to Have

  • GLP-1 Experience: GLP-1 prescribing experience or structured weight management exposure

  • Specialist Training: SCOPE certification or other formal obesity medicine training

  • Digital-first: Time at another leading digital-first provider

  • Governance Experience: Audit or QI leadership

  • Startup Pace: Comfortable with a protocol that iterates monthly — we're still early

🎯“You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market rate and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: £75 per hour plus equity. Paid per session, never per prescription

Benefits

data.title: Learning and Development Lead - Clinic
data.description:
This is a brilliant opportunity for an experienced Learning & Development professional who wants to build something, not simply inherit it.

As our clinical teams continue to grow, we are looking for someone to take real ownership of how our doctors, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals are onboarded, trained and prepared to work confidently at Montu.

You do not need to be a clinician. What we need is someone who really understands learning, knows how to engage experienced professionals and can take complex systems, processes and information and turn them into practical training that works.

There is plenty to shape, improve and build in this role, so if you love creating great learning experiences and seeing people go from day one to confident and capable, this could be a really exciting opportunity.

What is the job?

Great patient care starts with people who feel confident, capable and fully prepared to work within Montu’s model of care.

As Montu continues to grow, we are looking for a Clinic Learning & Development Lead to take ownership of how our clinicians are onboarded and trained.

You will build and deliver structured training for all our healthcare professionals including doctors, nurses, pharmacists and physiotherapists, helping them become ready to work independently as efficiently and safely as possible.

This is a hands-on role covering everything from systems and formulary training to eligibility, prescribing processes and patient pathways. You do not need to be a registered healthcare professional. We are looking for an experienced trainer who can take complex information and turn it into clear, practical learning.

What will you be doing?

Own clinician onboarding

You will manage the training journey from a clinician joining Montu through to being ready to work independently.

You will:

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding for different clinician groups alongside our lead training clinician.

  • Coordinate training and track progress.

  • Identify knowledge gaps, delays or barriers and provide additional support where needed.

  • Continuously improve the onboarding experience.

Deliver practical Montu training

You will train clinicians on the systems, processes and pathways they need to work effectively at Montu, including:

  • Clinical systems and patient portal

  • Patient eligibility and suitability

  • Prescribing processes and standards

  • Prescription pathways

  • Documentation and record keeping

  • SOPs, governance and escalation pathways

Training should be practical and engaging, using demonstrations, workshops, system practice, case-based learning and assessments.

Build capability

You will develop clear learning outcomes and assess understanding throughout training, working closely with clinical leaders and subject matter experts to ensure content remains accurate and up to date.

Clinical standards and prescribing guidance will remain governed by Montu’s clinical leadership. This role is focused on learning, capability and operational readiness rather than making independent clinical decisions.

Improve and scale training

You will use feedback, data and operational insight to make onboarding faster, clearer and more effective as Montu grows.

This will include developing training materials and learning pathways, maintaining a central source of training content and supporting refresher training and the rollout of new systems and processes.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with:

  • Strong experience in training, learning and development, onboarding or operational enablement.

  • Experience designing and delivering structured training programmes.

  • Excellent facilitation and coaching skills.

  • Confidence training experienced professionals.

  • The ability to simplify complex information.

  • Strong organisation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience delivering systems and process training.

  • A continuous improvement mindset.

Experience within healthcare or another regulated environment would be a strong advantage, particularly if you have trained healthcare professionals.

You do not need to be a registered healthcare professional or have experience within cannabis-based medicine.

What does success look like?

You will help us create:

  • Faster progression from joining Montu to independent working.

  • A consistent onboarding experience across clinician groups.

  • Fewer avoidable delays and knowledge gaps.

  • Confident clinicians who understand Montu’s systems, formulary and pathways.

  • A scalable training framework that can grow with the organisation.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days holiday, rising to 27 after one year and 30 after three years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for development and progression

  • The opportunity to build and shape an important training function within a rapidly growing healthcare organisation

  • A dynamic, collaborative and patient-focused working environment

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines.

We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, ensuring everyone joining our clinical teams receives consistent, high-quality training will be fundamental to maintaining the quality of our service. This role will play a central part in making that happen.
