data.title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
data.description:
Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology

  • A genuine interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Flexible working with full time or part time options

  • Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare scheme

  • No night shifts and no on call

  • CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training and development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu

  • Specialist training delivered by experts

  • Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems

Working arrangements:

  • Fully remote with flexible working hours and days

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. Job Summary

This is a high-impact, newly created role supporting the growth of Tillo's channels as the business continues to scale its global footprint. As a dedicated Finance Business Partner, you will be the finance point of contact for a channel, bridging local performance and Group reporting, and helping the channel deliver profitable, disciplined growth.

Reporting centrally into Group FP&A, you will support the channel's forecasting and reporting while acting as its commercial finance partner: building trusted relationships with commercial and local leadership teams, standardising local data into Group reporting formats, supporting cashflow and working-capital forecasting, and giving local leadership the tools to make disciplined, margin-accretive commercial decisions. This role sets the template for how Group Finance partners with and scales its channels, so it suits someone who wants to shape ways of working rather than inherit them.

Day to day this role will

Business Partnering & Commercial Support

  • Act as the trusted finance partner to commercial and local leadership teams, building strong relationships that make finance a growth partner rather than an oversight function.

  • Give local leadership clear visibility of their drivers, key metrics and growth levers, translating financial data into commercial insight they can act on.

  • Identify and quantify opportunities to improve margin, refine channel pricing and structure commercial deals for profitable growth.

  • Provide ROI and decision-support tools for new commercial deals, product expansion and pricing, driving disciplined growth and margin expansion.

  • Analyse channel performance, product-mix margins and OpEx variances to surface levers for improvement.

Cashflow Forecasting and Treasury Support

  • Support cashflow and working-capital forecasting for the channel, including multi-currency exposure, feeding into Group treasury and liquidity planning.

  • Partner with Group Treasury to capture cash and operational synergies and optimise working capital.

  • Help embed robust cash-forecasting frameworks and disciplines within the channel.

FP&A and Reporting

  • Own the channel's forecasting levers, unit economics and rolling 12-month projections, integrating local performance seamlessly into the Group forecasting and planning process.

  • Prepare and deliver regular performance reporting on financial KPIs and channel flash updates, with strong storytelling and clear communication to a diverse range of stakeholders including Group leadership and the Board.

  • Standardise data into Group and Board reporting formats, protecting investor and SLT confidence and ensuring board-level clarity with no rework or delay.

  • Act as a finance data steward for the channel, centralising and validating data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and integrity.

  • Continuously seek to automate and scale reporting, building user-friendly reports and dashboards and documenting processes so the approach is repeatable across channels.

Job Summary:

As Tillo continues to scale its global footprint, we are seeking a highly analytical, hands-on Treasury Manager to take immediate ownership of our global cash operations, capital structures, and advanced liquidity forecasting frameworks. Operating within a high-volume fintech ecosystem driven by complex client floats and commercial brand credit mechanics, this high-visibility role requires an exceptional finance professional. You will be responsible for mastering intricate operational fund flows, establishing an airtight daily cash positioning rhythm, and designing rigorous compliance frameworks to optimise our capital structure and support corporate initiatives

Day to day this role will

  • Establish Daily Cash Positioning: Run tight, daily global cash positioning across multiple legal entities and currencies to ensure flawless operational execution and strategic cash movements.

  • Optimise Working Capital: Manage and monitor the delicate balance of client floats and pre-funded brand credit cycles, ensuring daily funding availability without creating operational pinches.

  • Own Rolling Forecasts: Build, maintain, and stress-test robust 13-week and 12-month rolling cash flow models to accurately project working capital needs and corporate funding liquidity.

  • Design and maintain strict treasury controls to track client fund flows, ensuring clear visibility, risk mitigation, and operational segregation between corporate liquidity and client cash.

  • Take full operational ownership of corporate credit facilities, confidently managing drawing mechanics, optimal utilisation, and repayment cycles.

  • Establish and maintain comprehensive financial compliance frameworks, including the proactive calculation of leverage/liquidity ratios and performance tracking against structured internal and external benchmarks.

  • Translate complex treasury positions, liquidity profiles, and capital efficiency metrics into clear, actionable insights directly for the Head of FP&A and the CFO.

  • Act as the lead / super-user for global corporate banking portals, owning user permissions, secure validation controls, and navigating international payment rails (SEPA, ACH, SWIFT).

  • Design and execute corporate foreign exchange (FX) hedging strategies to protect commercial margins against currency volatility as international volume scales.

  • Evaluate, select, and onboard tier-1 global banking partners to support Tillo's expansion into new international markets and currencies.

  • Once daily operations and reporting are thoroughly optimised, evaluate the long-term treasury technology roadmap, including the potential selection and phased implementation of a Treasury Management System (TMS)

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience hands-on managing corporate financing facilities (e.g., RCFs or revolving credit lines), calculating complex financial covenants, and delivering formal reporting packages.

Was machst du bei uns als...

…(Senior) Account Executive? In dieser Rolle gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft der digitalen Patientenversorgung mit und treibst das Wachstum von samedi entscheidend voran. Als Teil unseres Regional Sales Teams übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Neukundengewinnung in Norddeutschland – von einzelnen Praxen bis hin zu MVZs. Mit deinem Gespür für Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und deiner Hunter-Mentalität identifizierst du gezielt neue Potenziale, sprichst Entscheidungsträger*innen proaktiv an und überzeugst sie von unseren Lösungen. Vom ersten Kontakt über Produktpräsentationen bis hin zum Vertragsabschluss begleitest du deine Interessent*innen professionell und baust langfristige, vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften im Gesundheitswesen auf.

Die Stelle ist unbefristet und du arbeitest zu 100% remote (Ausnahme: Kundentermine vor Ort). Idealerweise befindet sich dein Wohnsitz im Westdeutschen Raum.

Mehr Insights rund um Ziele, Tech Stack und Team gibt Philipp, unser Head of Sales, in diesem Video.


Wir geben alles - Deine Vorteile

  • Verbinde Arbeit und Privatleben durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • 30 Tage Urlaub per Kalenderjahr
  • Sabbatical (abhängig von der Dauer der Betriebszugehörigkeit)
  • Provisionsfreie bAV

  • Zuschuss zur Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft
  • 40 Tage Workation pro Jahr im europäischen Ausland


Gemeinsam verbessern wir das Gesundheitssystem - Deine Aufgaben

  • Erstkontakt zu potenziellen Neukunden und proaktive Ansprache von Entscheidungsträger*innen
  • Durchführung von Produktpräsentationen, remote und direkt in Einrichtungen vor Ort
  • Umwandlung warmer Leads aus Marketingkampagnen in zufriedene Neukunden
  • Erstellung von Angeboten sowie Pflege aller Aktivitäten im CRM
  • Teilnahme an Messen und Veranstaltungen in der Region zur aktiven Leadgenerierung
  • Analyse von Marktpotenzialen und Identifikation neuer Wachstumsmöglichkeiten
  • Gezielter Ausbau des Netzwerks im Gesundheitswesen bei Arztpraxen und medizinischen Versorgungszentren


Du begeisterst uns - Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich
  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Bezug zum Gesundheitswesen
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der aktiven Neukundengewinnung
  • Überzeuge deine Kunden mit den Mehrwerten unserer Lösung, die du auch proaktiv kommunizieren kannst
  • Sicherheit im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern über verschiedene Hierarchieebenen
  • Technikaffinität und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Reisebereitschaft im Hamburger Raum bzw. Norddeutschland
  • Exzellente Deutsch- & gute Englischkenntnisse


Über uns

samedi – hier trifft Tech auf Gesundheit. Hier wird die digitale Transformation des Gesundheitswesens vorangebracht und mitgestaltet. 
Als eines der führenden E-Health-Unternehmen in Europa sind wir die Brücke zwischen Ärzten und Patienten. Unsere intelligente Softwarelösung bietet effiziente Ressourcenplanung und Online-Terminbuchung, unter höchster Datensicherheit. Durch unsere Arbeit unterstützen wir die Beziehungen zwischen allen Beteiligten im Gesundheitswesen, ermöglichen moderne digitale Behandlungsformen und verbessern dadurch die Gesundheitsversorgung deutlich. 
Wir wollen dazu beitragen, dass Menschen schneller gesund werden und alle einen einfachen und guten Zugang zu Gesundheitsbehandlungen bekommen. Wir etablieren digitale Gesundheitsservices.


Du hast Lust mit uns durchzustarten?

Sende uns deine Bewerbung mit deinem Lebenslauf und einem Nachweis deines höchsten Bildungsabschlusses direkt über den Bewerben-Button.
Was nach deiner Bewerbung auf dich wartet:    1. Erstgespräch mit Philipp    2. Case Study inkl. Rollenspiel mit unserem Sales Team    3. Cultural Add mit Alex
Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich bei uns zu bewerben! Wir bei samedi schätzen Leidenschaft, Engagement und den Willen, Neues zu lernen und wer weiß, vielleicht bist genau du die Verstärkung, die wir suchen. Da wir als Unternehmen im Gesundheitswesen mit sensiblen (Patienten-)Daten arbeiten, legen wir großen Wert auf Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Das bedeutet, dass wir im Laufe des Bewerbungsprozesses eine Identitätsprüfung durchführen (bitte halte dafür deinen Personalausweis bereit) und dich bitten, uns dein Zeugnis des höchsten Bildungsabschlusses zukommen zu lassen. Keine Sorge, deine Noten sind uns dabei nicht wichtig. Uns geht es vor allem darum, dich als Person kennenzulernen und die formalen Anforderungen für unser Sicherheitskonzept zu erfüllen.
Für mehr Einblicke in unsere Unternehmenskultur folge uns auf Instagram: samedipeople

Director, Technical Program Management & Engineering Business Operations
Head of Growth
data.description:
Head of Growth

Location: London (hybrid) · Reports to: Founder & CEO

 
 

ABOUT LUA

Lua is the Agent OS. We build digital employees — agents that do a real job end to end: they read a company's own systems, make the decision, take the action, and get a little better every time they run. Not chatbots that answer questions — digital workers that do the work, on the company's own data and workflows, and everything they build stays owned by the business. Teams write their logic on Lua (agents, skills, tools, jobs, webhooks, guardrails) and we run the hard parts underneath: infrastructure, multi-provider model orchestration, data, channels (WhatsApp, Slack, Email, Instagram, Messenger, a voice-capable website widget, HTTP API) and monitoring.

Our customers are the companies that run their markets — the operator of one of the world's most-visited heritage sites, a major travel-and-hospitality group, the largest supermarket chain in its country, a listed conglomerate spanning healthcare and consumer goods, large regional banks, social-commerce companies and a microinsurer covering over a million people — across Africa, the Middle East and South Asia. Together they employ 64,000+ people and turn over $5bn+ a year. Backed by Y Combinator, we've raised $5.8M.

Every one of those deals was sold by a founder in a room. It works, and it doesn't compound. Workspaces is how that changes.

 
 

THE ROLE

We're launching Workspaces: the place where a company's people and its agents do the work together, built around a shared memory of everything the team knows. It is the first Lua product one person can pick up on their own, get value from the same week, and pull three colleagues into the week after. One user becomes a team, a team becomes a company, and the enterprise conversation we run today starts from inside the account instead of outside it.

You own that motion. This is not a brand-and-budget role, and it isn't a marketing function you'll be handed. You own one question: what is the shortest path from a single signup to a team that would notice if Lua disappeared? You'll answer it with experiments, prove it with numbers, and then make it repeat.

Treat the honesty here as part of the offer. We cannot tell you our CAC to LTV. We cannot tell you which channels work for us. There is no instrumented funnel, no agreed activation metric and no attribution in place. You will establish all of it, then spend against it. You are the person running the experiments personally for the first two quarters, and the person hiring the team that runs them after that. When you build that team it will span product, analytics, performance, channel, brand, community and SEO. None of those hires happen before you know which ones the data asks for.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • The first user, and the fifth. Own signup → activation → habit → invite → paid, end to end. Define what activation actually means for Workspaces, instrument it, and take responsibility for the number every stage produces.

  • The loop inside the product. Design the referral, invite and collaboration surfaces that turn one user into a team: shared artefacts, agents worth showing a colleague, network effects that make the next seat obvious. Ship these with product and engineering rather than around them.

  • Channel prioritisation, from a standing start. Run the portfolio: performance, community, creator and influencer partnerships, content and SEO distribution. Decide what gets funded on CAC, payback and incrementality. Find out where our users already are, get there cheaply, and kill what doesn't pay.

  • The experimentation engine. Keep a live backlog of a hundred bets and a cadence that clears it: hypothesis, prioritisation, readout, decision. Build a library of learnings so the company gets smarter every month, and make the readouts short enough that people actually read them.

  • The growth stack, from zero. Stand up event tracking, analytics, attribution, A/B testing, lifecycle and email automation, and experiment tracking. Agree the data model with engineering so every test is measurable on day one. Self-serve dashboards the whole company trusts, owned by you.

  • The handoff to revenue. Decide when a self-serve account becomes a commercial conversation, and give the founders and the sales team a signal they can act on. Product-led and founder-led are one pipeline, and you own the join.

  • The growth roadmap. Bring a point of view in week one, sharpen it against the product, and keep it current enough that anyone in the company can read what we're testing this month and why.

 
 

THE KPIS YOU'LL OWN

  • Activation rate. Share of signups reaching a first working agent, and how fast that share climbs. This is the one that matters most; the rest are how you get there.

  • One-to-team expansion. Time from first user to fifth inside an account, and the share of accounts that make the jump at all. This is the whole thesis of Workspaces, expressed as a number.

  • Loop efficiency. Viral coefficient and cycle time on the referral and invite mechanics you build, measured honestly.

  • Experiment throughput and hit rate. Experiments live per week, and the share that produce a decision rather than a shrug.

  • CAC and payback by channel. Baselined in your first quarter, defended every quarter after, with budget moving toward whatever earns it.

 
 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We need an operator who is analytical to the bone and happiest with their hands on the funnel. You have built this before, at least once, at a company small enough that you did the work yourself.

ZERO TO ONE, PROVEN

  • You've taken a self-serve product from a few hundred users to a few thousand and built the repeatable motion that got it there. You can walk us through what you tried, what failed, and which two things ended up mattering.

  • You've worked without a baseline. Landing in a company with no funnel data and no proven channel is the normal state of your career, not a shock.

  • You'll be more interesting to us if that growth was B2C, prosumer or SMB than if it was mid-market demand generation. Workspaces looks like the former.

ANALYTICAL BY DEFAULT

  • You live in the data: SQL-comfortable, fluent in funnel maths, cohort analysis, LTV/CAC and statistical significance. You form opinions from numbers and change them the same way.

  • You are curious in a way that shows up in your work: you ask the second and third question, and you'd rather find the surprising answer than the flattering one. We index on this heavily.

EXPERIMENT DISCIPLINE

  • You've personally run a high-velocity testing programme and can show us the system that sustained it: the backlog, the prioritisation, the readouts.

  • Practically: we'll ask you early for a growth roadmap and an experiment backlog for Workspaces, built from a product demo and a funnel sketch. The people who do well here enjoy that exercise.

PRODUCT-MINDED

  • You've shipped growth features with product and engineering, not just campaigns around them. In a product-led motion the product is the channel and you work accordingly.

  • You've chosen and implemented your own analytics and growth stack. You don't need a data team to get moving.

AN OWNER

  • You set your own targets, hold yourself to them, and report progress with total transparency, including the weeks it went badly.

  • You're comfortable being the whole function now and a manager of specialists later, and you know which mode you're in.

 
 

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • You've grown an AI, developer-tool or workflow-automation product.

  • You designed a referral or viral loop that materially moved acquisition, and you can show the maths.

  • You've grown a product where messaging channels carried real volume: WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram, Slack.

  • You've hired and managed growth engineers, marketers or analysts.

  • You can produce or direct creative for paid and social yourself when speed matters.

 
 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • 90 days. Funnel instrumented, activation metric agreed, baseline CAC and conversion established, first wave of experiments shipped and read out to the company.

  • 6 months. A weekly experiment cadence running, one channel and one in-product loop showing compounding returns, and a defensible view of which channels to fund next.

  • 12 months. A growth engine: the loops, the stack, the playbook and the first two hires, converting spend predictably into teams on Workspaces.

 
 

WHY LUA

  • You own the entire growth surface of the product that changes how this company sells. No committees, no queue.

  • You work directly with the founders. Your experiments ship the week you design them.

  • We are early enough that the playbook is yours to write, and funded well enough that you get to run it. Backed by Y Combinator, $5.8M raised.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity. You're building the engine, so you should own a piece of it.

 
 

HOW TO APPLY

Send us one thing you've grown: a funnel, a loop, a channel. Tell us the numbers before, the numbers after, and what you'd have done differently. Send your CV alongside it.

See our other open roles at jobs.ashbyhq.com/lua.

data.title: Product Manager (Senior/Staff-level)
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Synthesia ships more product, faster, than we ever have. AI has collapsed the cost of building which means the hard part is no longer making things, it’s making sure people actually adopt them. That’s the job of Growth, and we’re changing how we do it: instead of bolting Growth on after launch to optimise, we’re embedding a Growth PM into every core bet from day one, so how a product acquires, activates and scales is designed in from the first cycle.

We’re hiring a Growth Product Manager to report to our VP of Growth. You'll own the Growth surface for one of those bets while helping build a growth-led way of working across the company.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own Growth for a core product area end to end, acquisition, activation, adoption and retention, baked into the roadmap from the start, not retrofitted.

  • Partner closely with the core product PMs and engineers who own the surface, bringing high-impact growth ideas and working out where they fit, and getting the primitives exposed that let you build and scale on top.

  • Design growth into the product itself: discovery-led acquisition loops, and experiences that get users to their job-to-be-done in a couple of clicks (sometimes without opening the editor at all).

  • Rally teams around specific, measurable outcomes and help each one hit its goal faster through what you build together.

  • Work across engineering, marketing and GTM to make funnel- and journey-thinking a normal part of how we build.

Who you are

  • AI-native. You’ve driven AI into how a product or team works - not just worked somewhere that does AI. You use it daily, you’re curious about how the stack works, and you keep up as it moves (fast).

  • Scrappy and comfortable in ambiguity. You’ve taken something 0→1, you move fast, and you don’t need a clean brief or a stable roadmap to make progress. Constant change energises you rather than blocking you.

  • A builder of credibility. You win trust across teams quickly and can get engineers, PMs and GTM aligned around growth - even when that’s a new way of working for them.

  • Technically fluent and genuinely curious. You can hold your own with engineers on how things work and where the trade-offs are.

  • Outcome-driven. You anchor on the right metric and move it.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Product Manager with exposure to Growth. Depth in a single specific lever is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Demonstrable experience driving AI-native product or ways of working.

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, 0→1, frequently-disrupted environment.

  • Strong communication and the personality to build credibility and influence across functions.

  • Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering.

Location

Remote from Europe or hybrid based from our London or Munich offices.

 

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

Benefits specific to UK:

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. This is a fast-paced role where no two days are ever the same - on any given day, you could be running a strategy call, working a retention, spotting an upsell opportunity, or providing best practice guidance. You'll also work closely with other teams across the business, giving feedback on product development and technical issues, and supporting launches of new product features.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

  • You have a background in Customer Success or Retentions, with real experience retaining customers and handling objections

  • You're a motivated self-starter who works well independently and is excited by the opportunity to help scale a business during a high-growth phase

  • You're highly organised with exceptional attention to detail

  • You are passionate about providing an exceptional customer experience and building lasting relationships

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluency in written and spoken English)

  • You're tech-savvy and genuinely open to picking up new tools and systems quickly, from our CRM to AI-assisted workflows - we care more about your curiosity and adaptability than which specific tools you've used before

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L2 Customer Success Manager at Street Group

  • Supporting our clients to achieve great results with Spectre; from proactively ensuring existing clients are getting the most out of the system through strategy calls, quarterly business reviews, and training sessions

  • Proactively identifying accounts at risk and working retention conversations and objection handling to keep customers on board

  • Implementing creative solutions to proactively resolve potential issues for customers before they escalate

  • Visiting clients face-to-face to build genuine relationships and get a first-hand view of their business

  • Ensuring feedback flows from Customer Success to the relevant business and product teams

  • Collaborating with the sales and tech team members to design and implement new product features that reflect the voice of our customers

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we’re driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you’re excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we’d love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Business Automation Specialist – Customer Care

About the Role

Customer Care at Perk is being rebuilt around automation and AI. This role is for someone who likes taking a messy operational problem and turning it into something that runs in production.

As an Automation Specialist, you'll design and ship the systems that cut manual work, make agents faster, and improve what customers actually experience. You'll work across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and whatever else the problem needs. Some days that's a workflow. Some days it's an AI tool with evals, guardrails, and a kill switch. The through-line is the same: get it from idea to live, then keep it reliable.

You'll partner with Operational Excellence, Customer Care Leadership, and Operations. You'll own delivery end to end, and you'll be measured on whether the things you build actually stick.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and AI tooling.

  • Wire up multi-system integrations that remove real manual effort, not just move it around.

  • Own projects from the first sketch through production and ongoing improvement.

  • Stand up proper testing and validation environments so "it worked in my scenario" isn't the bar.

  • Turn business problems into technical designs, and flag new automation opportunities as you go.

  • Stay close after launch: watch adoption, fix what breaks, iterate on what underperforms

Build

  • Write automations that are maintainable, documented, and safe for someone else to pick up.

  • Monitor production systems, debug fast, and keep operational impact low when things go wrong.

  • Know when Make/Zapier-class tools are enough, and when the problem needs a different approach.

  • Keep an eye on new automation and AI capabilities, and bring the useful ones in deliberately.

Raise the bar

  • Be the person others ask when they're stuck on architecture, platform limits, or how to ship AI safely.

  • Review builds before they go live when that review actually reduces risk..

  • Create reusable components, patterns, and standards so the next build is faster and cleaner.

Teamwork

  • Sit with Opex and Operations until you understand the real problem, then design the right fix.

  • Shape discovery and scoping so solutions stay practical and maintainable.

  • Keep stakeholders clear on progress, risks, dependencies, and dates.

  • Feed operational feedback back into the next version.

What We're Looking For

  • Shipped production automations on Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar not just demos.

  • Worked with Airtable or comparable systems as a real ops backbone, not a side spreadsheet.

  • Built LLM-powered workflows with prompt craft, evaluation, and guardrails — and knows when the model shouldn't act alone.

  • Strong at debugging production systems under time pressure.

  • Can turn a fuzzy business request into something scalable and supportable.

  • Comfortable working with both technical and operational partners.

  • Prefers speed and ambiguity over perfect specs.

How We'll Know You're Winning

  • Automations that meaningfully cut manual work in Customer Care.

  • Multi-system builds that stay reliable once they're live.

  • High reliability, performance, and adoption — not just "launched".

  • Clear gains in operational efficiency, agent experience, and customer experience.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 30-45mins Virtual
Assessment Interview - 30-60mins - In-person interview

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

As the Research Analyst for the Strategic Communications team, you will build iwoca's evidence base for public policy arguments. You'll become the expert on what iwoca's data can tell us about our impact - on customer outcomes, business survival, pricing, and the wider economy - and translate that into compelling materials for policymakers, journalists, and senior stakeholders.

You'll work alongside our communications team and report to the Director of Strategic Communications, with regular interaction with iwoca's executive team. The role sits at the intersection of data, policy, and communications and collaborates with Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, and Investor Relations to extract insights and translate them into materials that shape how iwoca is understood externally.

There's a clear career trajectory here. With time, you could build a new research function, or you might discover that you love the communications and become a data-driven PR professional. Either way, you'll have the opportunity to shape the role and take on real responsibility from day one.

The responsibilities

  • Extract and analyse data from iwoca's loan book, loss rates, customer outcomes, and pricing distributions to uncover insights that support our public positioning.

  • Build and maintain briefing packs on key topics: business survival rates, pricing, personal guarantees, automation, and regulatory impact.

  • Translate complex data into clear, defensible documents with key statistics, talking points, and visualisations for non-technical audiences.

  • Coordinate with external research partners (e.g. Capital Economics) - preparing data packages, briefing them on our business, and quality-assuring their outputs.

  • Work with Comms to respond rapidly to media or policy inquiries - producing accurate data when inbounds come in.

  • Publish work and write data-driven content for iwoca's website, supporting marketing lead generation, media and investor relations.

  • Support the Comms team on existing data-driven PR initiatives such as our SME Expert Index and Business Hotspots research.

  • Run a quarterly review process with senior stakeholders to identify emerging concerns and commission new analysis.

The requirements

  • Comfortable working with raw data in Python or SQL, including cleaning, transforming, and visualising datasets to uncover insights

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • Use AI tools to explore data, generate insights, and improve workflows, with a focus on accuracy and analytical rigour.

  • Strong analytical skills with a structured approach to problem-solving – you're curious, methodical, and comfortable getting to the root of a messy or ambiguous question

  • An excellent communicator – you can take complex data and translate it into simple, compelling narratives for colleagues in comms, policy, or the executive team.

  • Self-starting and adaptable - able to work independently in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly

  • Comfortable moving between strategic thinking and hands-on execution – whether it's investigating a data anomaly or presenting findings to senior leadership

  • Academic or practical experience in a quantitative field, such as Economics, Finance, Product, Maths, Engineering, or Computer Science

  • Previous experience in a role involving data analysis and AI - whether in consulting, policy, finance, journalism, or a research setting. Salary is flexible based on experience.

  • An interest in small businesses and the policy debates around SME finance - you don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious about the space.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in or with government, regulators, think tanks, or policy teams

  • Familiarity with economic impact modelling or econometric analysis

  • Experience producing research for external publication or media use

  • Understanding of UK financial services regulation or the alternative lending market

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

Compensation: £32K – £55K

  • • £32K – £55K

data.title: Management Accountant
data.description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the Role:

We are looking for a commercial, proactive Management Accountant to join our Operational Finance team.

In this role, you will take ownership of our month-end close process, deliver accurate financial reporting, and partner with FP&A and operational teams as Motorway continues to scale. You will also play a key role in maintaining our tax and audit compliance, while actively looking for ways to improve and automate our finance processes.

This is an ideal role for a recently qualified (or nearly-qualified) accountant (ACA/ACCA/CIMA) looking for their first move out of practice into a fast-paced scale-up, or an experienced Management Accountant seeking a varied, high-impact role in tech.

What You'll Do:

Month-End & Financial Reporting

  • Take full ownership of the month-end close, ensuring accurate and timely reporting in line with UK GAAP/IFRS.

  • Post monthly journals, accruals, prepayments, and manage balance sheet reconciliations in NetSuite.

  • Partner with the Accounts Receivable Manager to reconcile complex, multi-channel revenue streams across the business.

  • Prepare monthly management accounts and actionable commentary for the Finance leadership team.

FP&A & Commercial Support

  • Work alongside the FP&A team to deliver monthly variance analysis against budget/forecast.

  • Support the annual budgeting and rolling forecast cycles.

  • Act as a key finance partner to operational teams, translating financial data into commercial insights.

Compliance, Audit & Process Improvement

  • Complete quarterly VAT returns and manage associated UK tax compliance.

  • Support the external audit preparation, acting as a point of contact for auditors during annual audits.

  • Assist with statutory reporting, including SECR/carbon reporting requirements and ONS survey submissions.

  • Identify bottlenecks in our finance workflows and help implement system and process automation to support company growth.

What You'll Bring

Requirements:

  • Qualification: Qualified ACA, ACCA, or CIMA (or in the final stages of exams with relevant practical experience).

  • Experience: Either making a first move from practice (Audit/Accounts) or proven experience within an in-house management accounting function.

  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency with Excel / Google Sheets (financial modeling, complex formulas, pivot tables).

  • Mindset: A self-starter attitude with strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in a dynamic, fast-evolving business.

  • Communication: Clear, confident communication skills with the ability to build strong cross-functional relationships.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite or similar cloud ERP systems.

  • Prior experience with multi-stream revenue reconciliations or tech/marketplace business models.

  • Exposure to VAT return preparation and audit readiness.

data.title: Senior Product Designer
data.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help expand the breadth and depth of the 9fin platform.

You’ll join a cross-functional product and engineering team solving complex, high-value problems for professionals across global debt markets, spanning AI-powered workflows, financial data and analysis, transaction intelligence, document management, and other emerging product areas.

You’ll help shape products used by teams at leading investment banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisory businesses - sophisticated users working with large volumes of complex information, where speed, accuracy, and trust are critical.

It’s a chance to shape frontier AI-native products inside a company using technology to transform one of the world’s largest financial markets.

What you'll work on


Product & Design Strategy

  • Partner with customers, Product Managers, engineers, and subject matter experts to shape product vision and design strategy — not just how it looks, but how it works and why it matters.

  • Synthesise research, feedback, domain expertise, and data to frame clear problems, and translate complex financial workflows into intuitive product experiences.

  • Run discovery to understand what users need, how they work, and where technology can create real value.

  • Align your work to clear outcomes, manage competing priorities, and focus your effort where it has the most impact in high-precision environments.

Designing AI-Native Workflows

  • Design interfaces that help users explore, understand, and act on AI-generated insights and complex datasets.

  • Translate model outputs into clear, trustworthy interfaces — with source attribution, confidence, transparency, and appropriate user control.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on feedback loops and evaluation workflows to improve AI-powered experiences in production.

  • Spot opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to real customer problems, prototyping new patterns where no playbook exists yet.

Craft & Collaboration

  • Own design end-to-end — flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI that hold up across edge cases and complex data conditions.

  • Work as an embedded partner to Product, Engineering, Data, and subject matter experts.

  • Communicate design rationale clearly and bring stakeholders along, especially in new or ambiguous territory.

  • Contribute to and evolve the design system to support increasingly sophisticated, data-heavy, AI-driven workflows.

About you

This role will be a great fit if you are:

  • Comfortable with complexity: you’ve designed for sophisticated users or high-stakes domains (fintech, enterprise SaaS, data platforms, professional tools). Financial markets experience is useful but not required — curiosity matters more.

  • A systems thinker: you shape workflows, behaviours, and trust, not just screens, zooming from the big picture to the finest interaction detail.

  • Focused on trust and precision: you think in edge cases, error states, and ambiguity, especially where AI is involved.

  • AI-native in how you work: generative AI is a natural part of your process, from research to prototyping to stress-testing ideas.

  • A natural prototyper: you find the fastest way to make an idea tangible, whether that’s AI tools, Figma, code, or a pencil sketch.

  • Energised by a blank page: you thrive defining something new and iterating quickly through ambiguity.

  • A strong communicator: you run discovery interviews, facilitate workshops, and know when to challenge, align, or move a team forward.

  • Skilled in your craft: fluent in Figma, comfortable choosing the right fidelity, and experienced contributing to a design system.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events



9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

data.title: Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) Moodle / PHP / E-Learning
data.description:
Über uns

velpTEC ist ein auf innovative Technologien ausgerichtetes Weiterbildungsinstitut, das Erfahrungen aus Wirtschaft, Zukunftsforschung und neuen Bildungsansätzen verbindet. Wir unterstützen Menschen durch unsere Bildungsangebote praxisnah dabei, ihre Fähigkeiten für künftige Zeiten zu stärken und damit aktiv ihren Lebensweg zu gestalten. In unserem Handeln legen wir Wert auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung, Fortschritt und Selbstbestimmung. Bereit für eine neue Mission? Dann entdecke jetzt deine Zukunftsperspektive bei velpTEC und werde Teil unseres multiprofessionellen und diversen Teams.
​
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung in Moodle, um unsere Lernplattform technisch weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam mit unserem Learning Design Team innovative Lernkonzepte in leistungsfähige digitale Lösungen zu übersetzen.


Was deine Aufgaben sein werden

  • Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Moodle-basierten Lernplattform
  • Entwicklung neuer Erweiterungen und Schnittstellen
  • Anpassung und Modernisierung bestehender Moodle-Komponenten
  • Analyse und Optimierung von Performance, Sicherheit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit
  • Mitarbeit an der technischen Konzeption neuer digitaler Lernangebote
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Learning Design Team zur Entwicklung innovativer didaktischer Konzepte
  • Integration externer Systeme über REST-APIs und Standards wie LTI oder SCORM
  • Unterstützung bei Updates, Releases und Qualitätssicherung
  • Technischer Support und Fehleranalyse für unsere Moodle-Umgebung
  • Dokumentation von Entwicklungen und Best Practice


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Moodle
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PHP sowie den Moodle Core  APIs
  • Erfahrung mit MySQL/MariaDB
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git
  • Gute Kenntnisse in HTML5, CSS3 und JavaScript
  • Kenntnisse in Webservices, REST-APIs und Authentifizierungsverfahren (OAuth, SAML, LDAP) sind wünschenswert
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Freude an Teamarbeit und Interesse an modernenTechnologien


Was dich bei velpTEC erwartet

  • Hybrides Arbeiten an einem unserer Standorte in Hannover, München oder Leipzig – oder vollständig im Homeoffice, wenn du weiter von unseren Standorten entfernt wohnst.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Kernarbeitszeit – Arzttermine, Kita und andere wichtige Termine sind kein Problem
  • Fixgehalt + Zielbonus + 100 € (in Vollzeit) monatliche betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach 6 Monaten + 15 % Zuschuss auf Eigenanteil + attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte
  • 3 bezahlte Educational Days pro Jahr für Weiterbildungen + 1 zusätzlicher Urlaubstag für Ehrenamt
  • Ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget von 600 € (in Vollzeit) nach 6 Monaten + Zugang zu über 13.000 Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und gemeinsame Erlebnisse
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und Offenheit für neue Ideen und Innovationen

data.title: Professorship (W2) in Data Science and Digital Systems (100%) (m/f/d)
data.description:
Characteristics

  • Fixed-term employment contract (initially for two years)
  • Full-time
  • Hannover, Munich, Leipzig, Remote
  • Published on 30.07.2026
  • Application deadline: 31.12.2026
  • Earliest start date: 01.08.2027
  • Teaching load of 18 SWS


About us

velpTEC is an education institute focused on innovative technologies, combining experience from business, future studies, and new educational approaches. Through our educational offerings, we support people in strengthening their skills for the future in a practice-oriented way, helping them actively shape their own paths in life – and from 2027 onward, also in higher education.
VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) is a private university of applied sciences currently undergoing the process of state recognition through the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture. Our degree programs are launching in the fields of digital technologies, engineering, and innovation-driven management – with a clear commitment to continuously expanding our portfolio and responding to new developments. We understand teaching as a space for shaping solutions for tomorrow. Our approach is project-based, competency-oriented, and closely interlinked with practice. We are looking for individuals who are eager to break new ground in higher education and want to actively help shape our innovative learning environment. We are filling a W2-Professorship in Data Science and Digital Systems (100%).


Your responsibilities

  • Program development: Contributing to the development of the Master's program in Technology Business Management, and assisting in recruiting students
  • Masterclasses and expert seminars: Conducting live sessions on big data, business intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and data-driven technologies in English
  • Student supervision and examination formats: Providing academic guidance, mentoring, and support for project and research work; designing and evaluating portfolio assessments, exams, and master's theses
  • Applied research: Conducting practice-oriented research and transfer projects in the areas of data science, data infrastructures, and digital transformation – in cooperation with industry and research institutions
  • Funding and cooperation: Initiating research collaborations and acquiring third-party funding to strengthen applied research at our university
  • Publications and presentations: Publishing research findings in academic journals and at relevant conferences, as well as representing the university at specialist presentations and industry events
  • Transfer: Willingness to participate in research-related product developments, founding/start-up ventures, and patent applications
  • University development: Contributing to the university's academic self-governance, helping to further develop the range of study programs, and participating in international collaboration


Recruitment and qualification requirements

The recruitment requirements for professors are governed by § 25 of the Lower Saxony Higher Education Act (NHG):

  • A completed university degree
  • Pedagogical-didactic aptitude confirmed through practical experience
  • Special aptitude for in-depth independent scholarly work, generally evidenced by an above-average doctorate in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Data Science, or related fields
  • Special achievements in the application or development of scientific findings and methods over at least five years of professional practice, of which at least three years must have been carried out outside the higher education sector – preferably in data analytics, digital systems, or data-driven business processes


In addition, we assume

  • The ability and willingness to conduct teaching, research, and transfer activities in English.
  • Willingness to develop and further build higher education teaching competencies – particularly in (generative) AI-supported teaching.


In addition, we value

  • Innovative spirit in teaching: Motivation to develop and apply new didactic formats in data science and digital systems education
  • Interdisciplinary openness: Readiness to collaborate with colleagues in AI, blockchain, robotics, and management
  • Practice and transfer orientation: Proven experience in industry or research projects related to implementing data science solutions or digital infrastructures in real-world contexts
  • International perspective: Experience in international contexts or motivation to integrate global developments in data and system sciences into teaching and research
  • Commitment to institutional development: Willingness to actively shape the foundation and growth of a new university
  • Research profile: A visible research focus in big data analytics, cloud systems, AI-based data analysis, or digital infrastructures
  • Knowledge and technology transfer: Understanding research as a bridge between science, industry, and society


What we offer

  • The opportunity to shape the development of a new university and its programmes right from its foundation.
  • A professorship with a clear focus on teaching, quality assurance, and applied research.
  • Interdisciplinary collaboration with colleagues in robotics, blockchain, additive manufacturing, and innovation management.
  • Modern digital infrastructure and an innovative environment without outdated structures.
  • Collaboration with the Center for Higher Education Teaching (Kompetenzzentrum Lehre) at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg on the development of higher education teaching competencies.
  • Fully remote in Germany or hybrid work from one of our offices in Hanover, Munich, or Leipzig
  • Flexible working hours coordinated within your team (no weekend work) – doctor's appointments, childcare, and other important commitments are easy to accommodate
  • 15% employer contribution to your company pension plan
  • 3 paid Educational Days per year for professional development + 1 additional day of annual leave for volunteer work
  • Access to 13,000+ fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass
  • Regular team events and shared experiences
  • Plenty of autonomy, varied responsibilities, and a culture that encourages new ideas and innovation


Application documents and further information

  • Please submit your application, together with the required documents, in English via our online portal. You can access the online portal through the "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" button. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by post or email.
  • The following application documents are expected; mandatory documents are marked with *: 
    • *Cover letter
    • *CV (including an overview of previous employment since your first university degree, providing information on subject-related and application-oriented professional experience relevant to the advertised professorship; supporting documents such as employment references are welcome)
    • *Final certificate from the last general education school attended
    • *Certificates and/or diplomas for academic degrees (e.g., diploma, bachelor's, master's, doctorate)
    • *List of teaching activities
    • *Evidence of pedagogical-didactic aptitude (e.g., certificates for higher education teaching training, evaluation results of courses taught, teaching-related awards or scholarships)
    • *List of research activities
    • *List of publications and, where applicable, presentations
    • If applicable, list of third-party funding acquisitions
    • If applicable, list of international experience and cooperations
  • Application documents must be submitted as scans. Please use the upload fields provided in the online portal. For your cover letter, use the "Anschreiben" upload; for your CV, use the "Lebenslauf" upload; and for your employment references, use the "Arbeitszeugnis" upload. For all other documents, please use the "Andere" upload.
  • The recognition of foreign educational qualifications requires proof of equivalence. Initial points of contact can be found via the portal www.anerkennung-in-deutschland.de or https://zab.kmk.org/de/zeugnisbewertung.
  • Equal opportunity and diversity are actively promoted and practiced at VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung). This position is explicitly open to people of all genders (m/f/d). Applications from female scientists are expressly welcomed.
  • Application costs will not be reimbursed. 
In the further course of the appointment procedure, candidates may be asked, upon request, to give a teaching session, outline a research project, and complete at least one interview. By submitting your application documents, you consent to them being forwarded to the Appointment Committee. Within the appointment procedure, certain persons/committee members have the right to inspect the documents. These include members of the Presidential Board, the Senate, the University Council, and the Appointment Committee, as well as the sponsoring institution (velpTEC GmbH). Furthermore, the Officer for Equality and Diversity, where applicable the Officer for (Severe) Disability, and the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture have the right to inspect the application documents. Application documents submitted to VTH – University of Applied Sciences in foundation (in Gründung) are handled in accordance with data protection requirements and are used and stored exclusively for the purposes of the appointment procedure. They will not be passed on to third parties. Upon conclusion of the appointment procedure, the application documents will be destroyed in compliance with the relevant data protection requirements. For any data protection questions, the data protection officers of velpTEC GmbH (
Your contacts

For questions regarding employment law, the appointment procedure, or the recruitment requirements, please contact Mr. Kay-Uwe Klaus; for content-related questions about the job posting, please contact Dr. Mattis Hartwig at Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Technik-Affinität: Du musst kein Entwickler sein, aber du solltest eine Faszination dafür haben, wie Software funktioniert. Themen wie Kubernetes, Server-Monitoring oder Cloud-Infrastruktur wecken deine Neugier.

Bist du Umgebungen leid, in denen CI wie ein Nachgedanke behandelt wird, ein Haufen Skripte, den niemand besitzt, und wo "der Build ist kaputt" einfach als normal akzeptiert wird? Wenn ja, haben wir eine spannende Möglichkeit für dich, unserem CI-Team bei Checkmk beizutreten und einen echten Unterschied zu machen! Bei Checkmk ist die Build- & Test-Plattform kein Beiwerk, sondern ein Produkt mit Entwicklern als Nutzern.

Wir haben als Unternehmen ehrgeizige und wachsende Ziele, und das prägt direkt unsere Entwicklungsumgebung. Mehr Entwickler:innen, mehr Tests, höhere Qualitätsstandards: Die Anforderungen an unsere Plattform werden von Jahr zu Jahr weiter steigen. data.title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
data.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position
  • Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)
  • Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis
  • Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets
  • Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:
  • Experience using ML for forecasting
  • Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform
  • Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via  

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
